summary: Group handed over to Red Cross as Israeli ministers approve list of more than 1,700 Palestinians for release Gaza ceasefire – live updates The first seven of the remaining 20 living Israeli hostages have been released by Hamas after more than two years in captivity in Gaza, according to the Israeli military.
